text: Aquí Mira. Si cruzaste la puerta detrás de nosotros, escucha.
delivery: a message recorded into a field radio, composed and direct
english: This is Mira. If you came through the door after us, listen.

text: Los celadores quieren una dirección sellada en sus tres placas, y solo sellan a los infractores.
delivery: a message recorded into a field radio, composed and direct
english: The Wardens want an address stamped on their three plates, and they only stamp offenders.

text: Se quedaron con mi orbe en la ventanilla. Recupéralo si puedes.
delivery: a message recorded into a field radio, a little wry
english: They kept my orb at the window. Take it back if you can.

text: Seguimos por la puerta lejana, más allá de su barrera. Sigue la luz.
delivery: a message recorded into a field radio, resolute
english: We're going on through the far door, past their barrier. Follow the light.

text: Día quince. Al alba, las islas se juntan a la deriva, y cruzamos con cuerdas mientras se tocan.
delivery: quiet journal dictation at the end of a long day
english: Day fifteen. At first light the isles drift together, and we rope across while they touch.

text: Todas las cuerdas se rompen a nuestro paso. Quien nos siga necesitará los puentes de los constructores.
delivery: quiet journal dictation, matter of fact
english: Every rope parts behind us. Whoever follows will need the builders' bridges.

text: Campamento en la última isla. Nyra habría revisado cada nudo dos veces.
delivery: quiet journal dictation, a fond smile in the voice
english: Camp on the last isle. Nyra would have checked every knot twice.

text: Grabé nuestra señal en el hielo, donde la nieve no pueda enterrarla.
delivery: recorded in the cold, practical and steady
english: I've cut our sign into the ice, where the snow can't bury it.

text: No te detengas en el hielo fino. La flecha señala el anillo.
delivery: recorded in the cold, practical advice
english: Don't stop on the thin ice. The arrow points to the ring.

text: Dejé la dirección del castillo para quien me siga. Solo responde en orden.
delivery: recorded, calm and warm
english: I've left the castle's address for whoever follows. It only answers in order.

text: Primero el agua, luego la espiral de raíces y después la media luna sobre los árboles.
delivery: recorded, calm and clear, naming each step
english: Water first, then the spiral of roots, then the crescent above the trees.

text: Es el último acertijo que te dejo. Después, el mar.
delivery: recorded, warm, a little wistful
english: It's the last puzzle I'll leave you. Beyond it, the sea.

text: Nyra.
delivery: live and close, overwhelmed with relief, almost a whisper
english: Nyra.

text: Sabía que seguirías la luz. La mantuve encendida en cada puerta.
delivery: live and close, tender, holding back tears
english: I knew you'd follow the light. I kept it burning at every door.

text: Trajiste nuestro mapa. Esta vez elegimos juntas la próxima travesía.
delivery: live and close, warm and hopeful
english: You brought our map. This time, we choose the next crossing together.

text: El camino a casa está abierto. Quédate a mi lado para la próxima.
delivery: live and close, warm and hopeful
english: The way home is open. Stay beside me for the next one.

text: Vamos. Hay más puertas.
delivery: live and close, a smile in the voice
english: Come on. There are more doors.

text: Aquí dentro se conserva su aire, Nyra. Puedes caminar. Por ahora solo soy luz, así que sígueme.
delivery: live and close, warm and a little amazed, gently leading
english: Their air holds in here, Nyra. You can walk. I'm only light for now, so follow me.

text: Luz de estrellas por una rendija, como el sol en el patio. Los espejos aún giran.
delivery: live, curious, recognising something familiar
english: Starlight through a slit, like the sun in the court. The mirrors still turn.

text: Un custodio de los constructores, más antiguo que los funcionarios. Desvía su sello con tu escudo.
delivery: live, wry about the keeper, then a practical tip
english: A keeper of the builders, older than the clerks. Turn its stamp aside with your shield.

text: La lente del pilón está bloqueada. Algo en esa repisa de arriba la mantiene cerrada.
delivery: live, thoughtful, looking up
english: The pylon's lens is held shut. Something up on that shelf is doing it.

text: Otra vez hielo y una placa. Desde ahí no puedes empujarlo, pero el enlace del orbe puede arrastrarlo.
delivery: live, practical, a small smile
english: Ice and a plate again. You can't push it from there, but the orb's tether can drag it.

text: Eso despertó el sello. Ahora, hielo arriba. Aún tienes mis piolets.
delivery: live, encouraging, a little proud
english: That woke the seal. Up the ice now. You still have my axes.

text: Agua de esporas. No te quedes quieta en esas piedras.
delivery: live, quick warning, calm
english: Spore water. Don't stand still on those stones.

text: Esa hiedra te aguantará. Arriba.
delivery: live, light and encouraging
english: That ivy will hold you. Up you go.

text: El sello está al final de ese pasaje, y de ahí sale el agua. Un solo aliento, Nyra.
delivery: live, serious and steady, then soft on her name
english: The seal is at the end of that passage, and the water pours out of it. One breath, Nyra.

text: Uno. La lección de la primera puerta.
delivery: live, quietly pleased
english: One. The first door's lesson.

text: Dos. Se inclinó ante ti. Creo que eso era un visto bueno.
delivery: live, amused
english: Two. It bowed to you. I think that was approval.

text: Tres. El sello se bebió la luz del puente. Vuelve balanceándote en el cable de los constructores.
delivery: live, practical
english: Three. The seal drank the bridge's light. Swing back on the builders' cable.

text: Cuatro. Buena escalada.
delivery: live, warm, brief
english: Four. Nice climb.

text: Cinco. Falta uno.
delivery: live, brief, focused
english: Five. One more.

text: Seis. Ya tenemos la dirección completa. Vuelve a la puerta.
delivery: live, relieved and eager
english: Six. That's the whole address. Come back to the door.

text: Seis mundos, una dirección. Nos conoce.
delivery: live, hushed, in awe
english: Six worlds, one address. It knows us.

text: Nunca se extinguieron, Nyra. Cuando sus mundos se apagaron, dejaron atrás sus cuerpos y se volvieron luz.
delivery: live, slow, tender, understanding something huge
english: They never died out, Nyra. When their worlds failed, they let their bodies go and became light.

text: Cada puerta que abrimos la mantenía despierta uno de ellos, para quien viniera después.
delivery: live, quiet, grateful
english: Every door we opened was kept awake by one of them, for whoever came after.

text: Y una dirección a la que nunca llegaron. La dejaron abierta para nosotras.
delivery: live, soft wonder, an invitation
english: And one address they never reached. They left it open for us.

text: Juntas, esta vez.
delivery: live, close, warm and certain
english: Together, this time.
